strips.title: From unwrapping to still using it — in real life

panels.head: Dec 25 — unwrap
panels.text: A small gift that fits the person, with the receipt tucked in the box.

panels.head: Jan — first use
panels.text: The thermometer reads in seconds; the bottle goes to work.

panels.head: Spring — the care step
panels.text: Pull the bottle gasket and wash it. Owners say mold is the usual complaint.

panels.head: Next year — still in use
panels.text: Useful gifts get used. Novelty ones get regifted.
